Structural Welder

Ironworks Co builds steel frames for bridges and public buildings across the mountain west.

Responsibilities

  • Weld structural steel using MIG and stick processes
  • Read blueprints and follow weld symbols
  • Keep the shop safe and tidy

Requirements

  • 3 years of experience welding structural steel
  • AWS D1.1 certification
  • Able to lift 50 pounds
